entrypoint: instrument run ROOT; instrument replay ROOT

files.protocol-binary-pair.json: Frozen contract and all12 source/input/base hashes
files.inputs/<key>/input.json: Unchanged saved input metadata including target, curve and base identity
files.inputs/<key>/system.sing: Unchanged complete Singular source, dp order, selector variables and witness suffix
files.certificates/controls.json: 128 independent multiplication checks,512 Boolean S3 checks,8 explicit small Hilbert matrices, inverse negatives
files.certificates/<key>.json: Full input, original coordinate rows, XOR inclusion witnesses, invertible matrix and inverse, all27 pair-product relation coefficient vectors, degree bounds
files.certificates/summary.json: 12 rows with exact degree or explicit error; certificate filenames (hashes in manifest.sha256)
files.replay.json: Fresh-process recomputation result and summary hash
files.manifest.sha256: SHA256 for every raw file except the manifest itself

encodings.field_elements: Unsigned DECIMAL strings, bit i is coefficient of z^i;0<=value<2^83. Parse arbitrary-precision integer, never floating point.
encodings.field_modulus_bits: Lowercase HEX bit polynomial including bit83
encodings.xor_mask: 21-digit lowercase HEX; bit r selects coordinate row r (0..82), not source equation index
encodings.packed_row: Array of16-digit HEX u64 words, lowest-index word first; bit j%64 of word j/64 is column j
encodings.columns: column i*ell+j is a_i*b_j, i,j zero-based
encodings.coordinate_equation_ids: 83 entries mapping coordinate r to one-based I[index] in full source;0 means no equation at that coordinate
encodings.matrix: ell rows by ell columns of decimal field strings, M[k][i]=w_i^(2^k)
encodings.pair_relations: pair k gives83 coefficients in K multiplying original Q_r. Check all ell^2 coefficients. coefficient_u128le_sha256 is hash of ell^2 16-byte little-endian coefficient encodings in column order.
encodings.hilbert_bounds: Arrays indexed by total degree0..55; exact INTEGER coefficients. Lower=(1+T)^27, upper=(1+2T)^27. These are bounds, NOT the full exact Hilbert function.
encodings.sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of exact stored bytes
encodings.input_identifiers: dataset-family-m2-target_kind; original,baseline,spike40 provenance retained even if sources coincide

scope: Original highest-form ideal only; exact degree requires full source, field, inclusion, inverse, lower and replay checks. Full HF, affine solving degree and global FFD/LFD not asserted.
